import socket, struct

def q(name, qtype):
    tid = 0x1234
    flags = 0x0100
    header = struct.pack('>HHHHHH', tid, flags, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    qname = b''.join(bytes([len(p)]) + p.encode() for p in name.rstrip('.').split('.')) + b'\x00'

    data, _ = s.recvfrom(4096); s.close()
    ancount = struct.unpack('>H', data[6:8])[0]
    rcode = data[3] & 0xF
    # skip header+question
    off = 12 + len(qname) + 4
    answers = []
    for _ in range(ancount):

            if l & 0xC0: off += 2; break
            off += 1 + l
        rtype, rclass, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack('>HHIH', data[off:off+10]); off += 10
